# SolitonLikeWaves

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Stable, localized wave patterns that propagate through a two-dimensional recurrent spiking neural network without dissipating, analogous to solitons in nonlinear physics. These waves could serve as robust information carriers in neuromorphic hardware, enabling reliable signal propagation across topology-aware neural fabrics.
